objective: Keep the Pomodoro countdown accurate when callbacks are delayed, preserve fractional pause/resume, stop at zero, restart completed cycles, and keep controls reachable on narrow or short screens without unnecessary motion.
selection_basis: Cyber Timer was one of the three existing low-ranked apps selected by the observed Autonomous Frame run 34027490412.

baseline.operation: Start WORK_CYCLE, then fast-forward 61000 milliseconds while allowing one delayed interval callback.

prior_candidate.remaining_defect: Its unchanged 465.421875px container clipped INITIATE and REBOOT at a 320px viewport.
prior_candidate.refinement: A bounded responsive override preserves the original visual identity while allowing narrow and short screens to reach every control.

evidence_boundary: This record establishes the supplied candidate's observed browser behavior. It is not evidence of capability transport qualification, model execution by Molter, pull-request submission, approval or deployment.
